description: This Java class defines a DeviceAdminReceiver for handling events related to a managed profile, including profile provisioning completion and component name generation.

classes.name: BasicDeviceAdminReceiver
classes.description: A receiver that handles events related to managed profiles, such as provisioning completion and providing its component name.

methods.name: onProfileProvisioningComplete
methods.description: Called when the managed profile has been provisioned; launches EnableProfileActivity.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns the ComponentName for the receiver class.
